# Feedback inbox — aws-gsi-faq

Edit input from reviewers, transcribed here by the orchestrator. See
`engine/feedback-intake.md` for how this is collected and routed. Reviewers never edit
this file — it's the machine's landing zone.

## Review surfaces
| Version | Surface | Link | Audience | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Internal review | Google Doc | https://docs.google.com/document/d/<example-doc-id>/edit | Internal, non-technical | Created, private — not shared yet |
| External (AWS) | — | — | Partner SA eval team | BLOCKED — needs editorial block stripped + 2 clearances + confidential diagram cleared |

Internal-review copy is the reader-facing content with the editorial block stripped, SVG
diagrams omitted, and a "not for external distribution" banner. Generated from draft.html.

## Items
One row per piece of input. type = editorial-fix | info-gap | clearance | out-of-scope.
status = open | applied | routed | rejected.

| # | Date | Reviewer | Channel | Location (section / Q) | The ask | Type | Status | Notes |
|---|------|----------|---------|------------------------|---------|------|--------|-------|
| — | — | — | — | — | _(none yet — awaiting first review round)_ | — | — | — |

## Routing log
As items are classified and routed, record what happened (which interviewer got an info-gap,
which owner got a clearance, when the council was re-run). Keeps the round-trip auditable.
